rule: Product capabilities extend existing Architecture Freeze V4 engine owners; do not create duplicate engine hierarchies.

capabilities.capability: implement governed multi-format financial ingestion beyond the current CSV-only browser flow (Excel/PDF/structured evidence where supported by existing architecture)
acceptanceCriteria: the implementation adds governed support for each format that the existing architecture can safely support among EXCEL, PDF and STRUCTURED evidence
focused tests prove every newly supported format and malformed/unsupported input behavior
documentation reflects the actual supported formats and evidence contract
documentation-only changes, test-only changes, or unchanged CSV-only behavior do not satisfy this capability

capabilities.capability: analyze normalized financial statements and expose explainable financial intelligence
compose executive KPI, dashboard and performance intelligence from verified platform evidence
provide explainable decision scenarios, expert-choice evaluation and recommendation evidence
turn approved managerial decisions into governed workflows, assigned work and outcome evidence
expose explainable financial analytics (ratios, break-even, cash-flow forecasting and anomaly detection) over the canonical ingested source and structured statement inputs
acceptanceCriteria: composes the existing realized analytics services without reimplementing financial mathematics
exposes the analytics through the tenant-scoped, RBAC-guarded runtime and browser surface
each section fails closed with the owning service's BLOCKED status rather than fabricating values
focused unit, runtime and application acceptance evidence exists

capabilities.capability: generate real downloadable report file artifacts (TXT/CSV/JSON/XLSX) from verified tenant-scoped results, with persistence, provenance and secure tenant-isolated download
acceptanceCriteria: ReportsEngine remains the single report owner and renders genuine file bytes for each claimed format
artifacts are persisted tenant-scoped and retrievable with SHA-256 integrity verification
downloads are authenticated, authorized and cross-tenant denied, with correct content type and disposition
no fake/renamed/display-only artifact is produced; unsupported formats fail closed
focused unit, runtime, application and security/tenant acceptance evidence exists
